stemMd: Which area had the highest successful-service proportion?

options.label: D
options.textMd: All categories have the same rate

explanationMd: Compute the rates separately: Urban: 72/80=90%; Suburban: 128/160=80%; Rural: 112/160=70%. Compare these proportions rather than raw successful counts. The highest rate is 90%.

distractorRationale.b: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 90%, 80%, 70%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.c: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 90%, 80%, 70%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.d: The ratios differ; equal rates cannot be inferred from the raw totals.
